div.head: Episc 10
div.ab: Et sacerdotibus pertinet in sua diocesi, ut ad rectum sedulo quemcunque iuuent, nec patiantur, si possint emendare, ut Christianus aliquis alii noceat, nec (non) potens inpotenti, nec (non) summus infimo, nec (non) prelatus minoribus (subditis), nec (non) dominus hominibus suis, nec etiam seruis suis (aut liberis molestus existat).

⁊ sacerdum gebyreþ eac on heora scriftscirum, þæt hi georne to rihte æthwam fylstan ⁊ na geþafian, gif hi hit gebetan magan, þæt ænig Cristen man oðrum derige ealles to swyðe, ne se maga þam unmagan, ne se hearra þam heanran, ne se scirman his gingran, ne se hlaford his mannum, ne forðan his nydþeowan.

And sacerdum gebyreþ eac on heora scriftscirum þæt hi georne to rihte æthwam fylstan and na geþafian, gif hi hit gebetan magan, þæt ænig Cristen man oðrum derige ealles to swyðe, ne se maga þam unmagan, ne se hearra þam heanran, ne se scirman his gingran, ne se hlaford his mannum, ne furðum his nydþeowan.

And likewise it is proper for priests in their parishes to readily assist each person to obtain justice and never permit, if they can correct it, any Christian to inflict injury on another all too greatly, neither the strong on the weak, nor the higher on the lower, nor the shire official on his inferior, nor the lord on his men, nor even his slaves.

Und Priestern ferner kommt in ihren Pfarrsprengeln zu, dass sie ernstlich jedem zu Rechte verhelfen und, wenn sie es abstellen können, nicht erlauben, dass irgend ein Christenmensch dem anderen allzu sehr schade, noch der Mächtige dem Machtlosen, noch der Höhere dem Niederen, noch der Amtsobere seinen Unterbeamten, noch der Herr seinen Untergebenen, und auch nicht einmal seinen Sklaven.

And it belongs further to priests in their parishes that they earnestly help everyone to justice and, if they can prevent it, not allow any Christian to harm another all too greatly: neither the powerful the powerless, nor the higher the lower, nor the official his subordinates, nor the lord his men, nor even his slaves.
